snippet.title: Reapercussions - Job Orientation for a new Balatro-like indie game!
snippet.description:
Reapercussions is an upcoming indie strategy game where you play as a Reaper collecting souls for Purgatory using the fabled death dice. Here's a breakdown of the upcoming game's features. Not included here is the multiplayer mode that is currently in testing. 

Coming early 2027

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5383750/Reapercussions/

Check out illi.gg for more info. 

#Reapercussions #balatro #IndieGame #GodotEngine #SteamNextFest
